Cool start to a warm week at Lake Tahoe

by Paula PetersonSunday, September 27, 2026 - 10:35pmSunday, September 27, 2026 - 10:35pm

Share this:

  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

Instaread

SOUTH LAKE TAHOE, Calif. – A touch of fall through Monday afternoon, with a 20-50% chance of light rain in western Nevada and snow showers above 9,000 feet across the eastern Sierra. Then, a warming and drying trend Tuesday through the remainder of the week, according to the National Weather Service (NWS) Reno. Afternoon highs shoot back up above normal with light winds prevailing. Maybe summer wants to stick around.

South Lake Tahoe forecast from NWS Reno:

Monday

Sunny, with a high near 64. Calm wind becoming north around 5 mph.

Monday Night

Mostly clear, with a low around 36. North wind around 5 mph becoming east after midnight. Winds could gust as high as 20 mph.

Tuesday

Sunny, with a high near 72. Calm wind becoming east around 5 mph.

Tuesday Night

Clear, with a low around 41. Calm wind.

Wednesday

Sunny, with a high near 79. Calm wind becoming east around 5 mph.

Wednesday Night

Clear, with a low around 46.

Thursday

Sunny, with a high near 82.

Thursday Night

Mostly clear, with a low around 48.

Friday

Sunny, with a high near 78.

Friday Night

Mostly clear, with a low around 46.

Saturday

Sunny, with a high near 78.

Saturday Night

Mostly clear, with a low around 46.

Sunday

Sunny, with a high near 79.
